# Jay Santoshi Watch

> Jay Santoshi Watch is a watch store and watch & clock repair shop in Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat, India. Rated 4.9/5 on Google from 209+ reviews.

## Key facts
- Name: Jay Santoshi Watch (also: Jay Santoshi Watch Co., Jay Santoshi Watch Company, Jai Santoshi Watch)
- Category: Watch store, watch repair shop, clock repair service
- Address: Shop No. 1, Swapna Shilp Complex, Nigam Nagar, Near ONGC, Visat–Sabarmati Highway, Chandkheda, Ahmedabad, Gujarat 382424, India
- Landmark: Near ONGC, Visat–Sabarmati Highway
- Phone: +91 93746 41275 / +91 90991 38100 (WhatsApp: +919374641275)
- Hours: Open daily, 10:30 AM – 9:00 PM (may change on festivals)
- Google Maps: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Jay+Santoshi+Watch+Chandkheda+Ahmedabad
- Independent shop, not an authorised service centre of any brand.
- Languages: Gujarati, Hindi, English

## Services
- [Watch Repair](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/watch-repair/): Repairs for all common brands of analog, digital and quartz watches: stopped watches, broken crowns, loose hands and more.
- [Watch Battery Replacement](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/watch-battery-replacement/): Fast cell replacement for quartz and digital watches, usually done while you wait.
- [Watch Strap & Chain Replacement](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/watch-strap-replacement/): New leather, silicone and metal straps, and resizing of metal chains by adding or removing links.
- [Watch Glass Replacement](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/watch-glass-replacement/): Replacement of cracked or scratched watch glass (crystal) for round and many shaped watches.
- [Watch Servicing & Cleaning](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/watch-servicing/): Cleaning, check-up and care for watches that run slow, fast, or haven't been looked after for a long time.
- [Wall Clock & Clock Repair](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/wall-clock-repair/): Repairs for quartz wall clocks, table clocks and alarm clocks, including movement (machine) replacement.
- [Wrist Watches for Men, Women & Kids](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/wrist-watches/): Analog, digital and fashion wristwatches for men, women and kids, for daily wear, office and gifting.
- [Wall Clocks](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/wall-clocks/): Wall clocks for living rooms, bedrooms, offices and shops, plus clocks for housewarming gifts.
- [Straps, Chains & Watch Accessories](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/watch-accessories/): Spare straps, metal chains, buckles, spring bars, watch batteries and other accessories.
- [Gift Watches & Clocks](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/services/gift-watches/): Watches and clocks for birthdays, weddings, anniversaries, Raksha Bandhan, Diwali and corporate gifting.

## Guides (short answers)
- [How Often Should You Change a Watch Battery?](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/how-often-to-change-watch-battery/): Most quartz watch batteries last about 1.5 to 3 years. Watches with lights, alarms, chronographs or digital displays usually need a new battery sooner. Replace a dead battery quickly, because an old cell can leak and damage the movement.
- [Watch Stopped Working? 7 Common Causes and What to Do](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/watch-stopped-working-what-to-do/): The most common reason a quartz watch stops is a dead battery. Other causes are a crown left pulled out, moisture inside, a damaged movement, or loose hands catching each other. Check the crown first. If the watch still doesn't run, get the battery and movement checked at a watch repair shop.
- [Watch Strap Size Guide: How to Find the Right Width and Fit](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/watch-strap-size-guide/): Strap width is the distance between the watch's lugs, in millimetres. Common sizes are 16, 18, 20 and 22 mm. Pick a strap that matches the lug width exactly. For metal chains, a shop can remove or add links so the watch sits comfortably, with about one finger's space under it.
- [Watch Water Resistance Explained: 30m, 50m, 100m and What They Really Mean](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/watch-water-resistance-explained/): Water-resistance ratings are lab test pressures, not safe diving depths. 30m (3 ATM) means splash-resistant only. 50m (5 ATM) is fine for hand-washing and light rain. 100m (10 ATM) is suitable for swimming. Water resistance weakens with age and after the back is opened, so have the gaskets checked.
- [Quartz vs Automatic Watches: Which Should You Buy?](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/quartz-vs-automatic-watches/): Quartz watches run on a battery, are very accurate, low-maintenance and usually more affordable. Automatic watches are mechanical, wind themselves as you wear them, need no battery, but are less accurate and need periodic servicing. For daily, worry-free use choose quartz. For craftsmanship and character choose automatic.
- [Wall Clock Buying Guide: Size, Style and Silent Clocks](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/wall-clock-buying-guide/): Choose a wall clock by room size and use. Large, bold clocks suit living rooms. Simple, easy-to-read clocks suit kitchens and offices. Silent sweep-movement clocks suit bedrooms and study rooms. Check that the numbers are readable from across the room and that the style matches your decor.
- [Watch Care Tips: 10 Simple Ways to Make Your Watch Last Longer](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/watch-care-tips/): Keep your watch away from heat, water it isn't rated for, magnets and hard knocks. Wipe off sweat after use, keep the crown pushed in, replace dead batteries quickly, and have the watch checked whenever the battery is changed. These simple habits can add years to a watch's life.
- [Watch Gift Ideas for Birthdays, Weddings, Raksha Bandhan and Diwali](https://jay-santoshi-watch.vercel.app/guides/watch-gift-ideas/): For a watch gift, match the style to the person: classic analog for office wear, sporty digital for students and active people, slim bracelet watches for women, couple watches for weddings and anniversaries, and wall clocks for housewarmings. Set a budget, know their wrist size if possible, and buy from a shop that offers after-sales help.
